Omitting multiple difference components or additional loops.
Confusing even difference degree with an even true arrival count.

Presenting the exponential upper bound as the exact logical error rate or critical scaling.
aspects.conclusion: All seven correctly interpret risk and scope. A vanishing upper bound is sufficient evidence of decodability; a nonvanishing upper bound cannot conversely prove nondecodability.
